threat_event: Attacker connects to the HMI through the remote desktop tool and raises the hypochlorite pump speed or changes other setpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist targeting internet-reachable water system HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote desktop tool always on in unattended mode; one shared password; no MFA; no session approval or log review
existing_controls: Mechanical stroke limit on the hypochlorite pump; analyzer alarm relays to the alarm dialer; hand-off-auto switches
treatment_plan: Turn off unattended access; named accounts with MFA for the 3 operators and named integrator technicians; integrator sessions only when the Chief Operator approves and watches; weekly review of the connection history

threat_event: Someone who knows or has guessed the shared remote desktop password connects to the HMI (former staff, integrator technician who has left, or a reused password)
threat_source: Former employee or contractor; credential stuffing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared password unchanged from 2023 until 2026-07-22; no rule for changing it when people leave; password kept in a spreadsheet all staff can open
existing_controls: Password changed 2026-07-22
treatment_plan: Named accounts (R-001); termination checklist covering every OT credential and key; password manager instead of the spreadsheet

threat_event: Ransomware on an office computer spreads across the flat network to the HMI computer and forces hand operation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI computer, PLC, gateway, and office computers on one network; Wi-Fi password shared with visitors; HMI computer unpatched with no managed malware protection
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching on office computers; MFA on email; hand operation possible
treatment_plan: Separate OT network with its own firewall rules (gateway is the only outbound path); guest Wi-Fi; HMI computer added to a managed malware tool approved by the integrator

threat_event: The PLC program or HMI project is lost (HMI computer failure, ransomware, or integrator unavailable) and cannot be restored to a known-good state
threat_source: Hardware failure; ransomware; loss of the integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The only copies are on the HMI computer and the integrator's laptop; no image of the HMI computer
existing_controls: Hand operation; integrator's own copy (age unknown)
treatment_plan: Integrator exports the PLC program and HMI project; encrypted copies on 2 offline USB drives (plant safe and Owner's office), refreshed monthly and after every change; HMI computer image

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known flaw in the unpatched HMI computer operating system or SCADA software
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No operating system or SCADA software updates since May 2024; outside the MSP contract
existing_controls: Plant network not directly reachable from the internet (office firewall)
treatment_plan: Patch plan with the integrator: test each update on the integrator's bench copy, install within 30 days, keep a record

threat_event: Attacker or malware downloads altered logic to the plant PLC
threat_source: Advanced or opportunistic attacker on the plant network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLC has no program password; key switch in remote-program; flat network
existing_controls: Mechanical stroke limit; analyzer alarm relays; hand operation
treatment_plan: Key switch to RUN (remote-program only during approved integrator work); PLC program password; compare running logic with the offline copy each quarter

threat_event: Phishing takes over a staff email account and leads to a fraudulent payment or payroll change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security training or phishing exercise; payment changes confirmed by email only
existing_controls: MFA on email, accounting, and payroll
treatment_plan: Annual training and quarterly phishing simulations; call-back rule for any change to bank details

threat_event: Customer personal information in the billing system is exposed through a staff account takeover or a vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank draft details for 410 autopay customers and portal credentials held by the vendor; no security terms in the vendor contract
existing_controls: MFA on staff accounts; card numbers on the processor's hosted page
treatment_plan: Ask the vendor for its SOC 2 report and breach notice terms (10-day agent notice under Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)); quarterly user review

threat_event: SCADA drawings, the emergency plan, and the device password spreadsheet are read by an attacker who takes over any staff email account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared folder open to all 7 staff; passwords in a spreadsheet
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Restricted OT folder for the Owner, Office Manager, and Chief Operator; password manager; delete the spreadsheet

threat_event: A Tier 1 notice after a cyber-caused treatment problem is late or does not reach all persons served
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No cyber trigger in the notice procedure; contact list only in the billing system (printout from October 2024)
existing_controls: Boil water template; door hangers; local radio contact
treatment_plan: Add the cyber trigger and the 24-hour decision point to the emergency plan; monthly printed contact list in the plant binder

threat_event: The continuous chlorine residual record is lost or altered during an incident and grab sampling does not start, causing a monitoring violation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Record kept only in the HMI historian and the remote monitoring trend; no written fallback step
existing_controls: Portable colorimeter; operators know the 4-hour rule
treatment_plan: Written fallback: grab samples every 4 hours on a paper log the moment the record is in doubt; daily comparison of HMI and remote monitoring values

threat_event: A hurricane causes days of power and cellular outage, flooding at Well 3, and staff unable to reach the plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida coastal-plain service area; one generator connection at Well 3
existing_controls: Standby generator with automatic transfer at the plant; fuel contract; emergency interconnect; boil water template
treatment_plan: Pre-storm checklist (fuel, chemicals, printed binder, staff lodging); elevate the Well 3 control panel at the next capital project

threat_event: During a multi-day SCADA outage the 3 licensed operators cannot staff the plant safely around the clock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only 3 licensed operators; no relief agreement
existing_controls: Operators did 2 days of hand operation in October 2024
treatment_plan: Written relief-operator arrangement with the county utility or a neighboring system; written hand-operation steps

threat_event: The SCADA integrator is compromised and its access or its copy of the PLC program is used against the plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator's technicians use the shared password; no security terms; integrator holds the program
existing_controls: None specific
treatment_plan: Security terms by contract addendum: named technicians, incident notice within 24 hours, approved sessions only, return or protection of company files

threat_event: The remote monitoring service is unavailable or compromised, so remote alarms stop or false values are shown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single remote alarm channel besides the dialer; write-back turned off
existing_controls: Alarm dialer independent of the service; write-back off; vendor SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: Keep the dialer as the alarm of record; test it monthly; turn on MFA (R-001 plan)

threat_event: The MSP's remote management platform is compromised and used against every office computer, and from there the plant network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP agent on all office computers; flat network; no MSP security evidence
existing_controls: MSP states its technicians use MFA
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review; incident notice within 24 hours in the contract; network separation (R-003)

threat_event: The office backup cannot be restored after ransomware or a deletion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup never restore-tested; 30 days of versions
existing_controls: Nightly backup by the MSP
treatment_plan: First restore test; quarterly tests; 90-day versions

threat_event: Operators come to rely on the anomaly detection feature, or ignore its noisy alerts, and miss or delay a real water quality event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on in June 2026 without review or validation
existing_controls: Fixed alarm limits and the alarm dialer remain
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: advisory only, labeled alerts, 60-day evaluation with a written result

threat_event: An operator changes a setpoint remotely by mistake, and nobody can see who made the change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared HMI login; no change log tied to a person
existing_controls: Operators confirm changes by phone with the Chief Operator
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts and remote accounts (R-001 plan); HMI change review each month

threat_event: Someone breaks into Well 3 or the elevated tank site and tampers with the RTU or modem
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Padlocks and fences only; no intrusion alarm at remote sites
existing_controls: Fence and padlocks; weekly site checks
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; reconsider a door switch on each RTU panel at the next capital project

threat_event: The plant's single internet line fails, stopping remote monitoring and remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One broadband line, no failover
existing_controls: Alarm dialer and modems use cellular, not the internet line
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; the dialer covers critical alarms

threat_event: The billing SaaS vendor is unavailable during a billing cycle
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single billing vendor
existing_controls: Cash reserve of about 45 days
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: An attacker on the internet signs in to the elevated tank modem with the default password and changes telemetry, so the high-service pumps run on a false tank level
threat_source: Opportunistic attacker scanning for exposed devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Modem web administration reachable from the internet with the default password; public address on the carrier plan (found in P07)
existing_controls: Web administration turned off and password changed 2026-08-12; tank level gauge at the plant
treatment_plan: Move both modems to a carrier private network plan with no public addresses; check both modems quarterly
